title: Etale-origin witnesses for the two restricted relative-adjoint values
statement:
Fix the global finite-field datum $k=\overline{\mathbf F}_q$ of characteristic $p_0$ [def-weil-finite-field-fiber], a prime $\ell
e p_0$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, a uniformizer $\varpi_E$ and $n\geq1$, and set $A=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^n$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Let $X,Y$ be finite-type $k$-schemes [def-weil-finite-type-morphism], let $f:X	o Y$ be proper [def-weil-proper-morphism] and let $g:Y'\hookrightarrow Y$ be an arbitrary open immersion [def-weil-open-immersion]. Put $X'=X	imes_YY'$ with projections $g':X'\hookrightarrow X$ and $f':X'	o Y'$ [def-pc-fibre-product]. On the ordinary constant-$A$ module derived categories of the small etale and pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories, def-weil-pbc-proetale-modules], write $
u_T^*$ for exact comparison pullback [def-sf-comparison-derived-pullback]. Let $f^	imes_e,f'^	imes_e$ be the ordinary etale right adjoints for the proper identity-open compactifications, and $Rf^!,Rf'^!$ the relative exceptional functors $
u^*f_e^	imes R
u_*$ [def-weil-exceptional-inverse-image, thm-sf-ambient-adjoint-class]. For $K_0\in D^+(Y_{\mathrm{et}},A)$ and $\alpha:
u_Y^*K_0\xrightarrow{\sim}K$, the two etale complexes
$$B_0=g'^{e,*}f_e^	imes K_0,\qquad C_0=f'^	imes_e g^{e,*}K_0$$
are bounded below. There are canonical isomorphisms, natural in $(K_0,\alpha)$,
$$
u_{X'}^*B_0\xrightarrow{\sim}g'^*Rf^!K,\qquad 
u_{X'}^*C_0\xrightarrow{\sim}Rf'^!g^*K,$$
using the comparison adjunction unit and the canonical pullback identifications. Thus these displayed pairs give objects in the witnessed full category [def-sf-etale-origin-subcategory]. No isomorphism between these two objects, and no unrestricted pro-etale ambient adjoint datum, is asserted here.

proof.text: The structure morphism of Y is locally of finite type over a field, hence Y is locally Noetherian. Its quasi-compact structure morphism makes Y quasi-compact. An open immersion into a locally Noetherian scheme is quasi-compact, hence Y′ is quasi-compact as well. Properness gives the identity-open compactifications of f and its pullback f′.

Apply the existing ordinary etale HasBoundedBelowUpperShriek instance over a quasi-compact target to f and f′, with exactly their specified compactification instances. Exact inverse image preserves bounded-below objects via mapDerivedCategoryPlus. This proves that g′* f_e^times K0 and f′_e^times g* K0 are bounded below. The existing quasi-compact-target amplitude argument already supplies the required finite bound, so no separate dimension choice or comparison-class adjunction datum is needed.

The ordinary derived comparison unit is invertible at K0 and at its exact etale pullback g* K0. Use isIso_derivedComparisonAdjunction_unit_app directly from the source Comparison module. Whiskering sends these unit components to isomorphisms under the specified etale exceptional adjoints and comparison functors.

Unfold only sfRelativeOpenOriginLeftMap, sfRelativeOpenOriginRightMap, sfRelativeAdjointOriginUnit and the comma projections. Every factor is now the image of a comparison-unit isomorphism, a component of sfDerivedComparisonPullbackIso or alpha.hom. Functors preserve isomorphisms and their composites are isomorphisms. This proves both requested IsIso assertions for the literally specified natural maps.

The unchanged constructor sfRelativeAdjointOpenOriginObjects uses the two lower-bound proofs and asIso of these very components in sfRelativeOriginObject. It retains the specified etale objects and their canonical realized isomorphisms without choosing witnesses.
